records.artwork/dr-minimal-monogram.prompt.txt: Use the attached image as the visual reference for a simple wedding monogram for Roselle and Darell. Replace its letters with the exact uppercase initials "DR": D first and R second. Match the reference's quiet, refined typography: tall high-contrast serif letters, very thin hairlines, elegant thick strokes, overlapping forms, and one smooth restrained sweeping calligraphic stroke beneath the letters. Keep both D and R clearly recognizable and visually balanced as a compact single monogram. The reference is an authority for simplicity and proportion, not text: do not retain A or any other reference letter. Use solid ivory-white lettering only, with a genuinely transparent background so it can sit on the invitation's sage or olive surfaces. No leaves, flowers, branches, botanical decoration, gold edging, texture, shading, 3D effects, frame, wreath, mockup, extra words, names, or date. Center the mark with generous margins; keep the flourish inside the canvas. The finished result should feel as simple and elegant as the provided reference, not more ornate.
records.artwork/dr-romantic-monogram.prompt.txt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: wedding invitation monogram for Roselle and Darell.
Primary request: Create an elegant, romantic monogram using the exact uppercase initials "DR", D first and R second. Make both letters immediately recognizable.
Style: bespoke fine wedding stationery; one tall, graceful, high-contrast serif D intertwined with a beautifully drawn calligraphic R. Refined long sweeping terminals, delicate hairlines and confident thicker strokes. Balanced negative space and tasteful restraint.
Composition: a single centered interlocking DR mark on a square transparent canvas, filling about 75 percent of the canvas with generous clean margins; flourishes stay fully within the image. A few subtle botanical curls integrated into the lettering, without a separate wreath or enclosing frame.
Color palette: deep muted olive green #5a6946 with tiny restrained champagne-gold #ac9b76 accents, designed to read crisply on ivory wedding stationery.
Text (verbatim): "DR". No names, ampersand, date, tagline, or other text.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, including the counters and spaces between flourishes; clean precise edges; visually graceful at small invitation sizes.
Avoid: crowns, hearts, rings, large flowers, busy decoration, lace plaques, gradients, 3D effects, mockups, paper background, shadows, watermarks, illegible or extra letters.
